task_name: Summarize vegetated area from an NDVI mask
task_description: Filter Sentinel-2 imagery by region, date, and metadata, mosaic and clip the imagery, compute and rename NDVI, apply a vegetation threshold mask, multiply the masked pixels by pixel area, and reduce the result over the region to summarize vegetated area.
original_task_description: The script calculates the extent of vegetated areas within a study region using Sentinel-2 imagery from July 2021. It computes NDVI from bands B8 and B4, applies a threshold (NDVI ≥ 0.369) to classify vegetation, masks non-vegetated pixels, and quantifies the total vegetated area in hectares. Outputs include a classified vegetation layer, an NDVI map with a color palette, and printed area statistics for vegetated, non-vegetated, and total regions.

task_description: Select precipitation imagery, filter the image collection to the target year, reduce the collection into an annual precipitation image, and compute polygon zonal mean precipitation with reduceRegions.

Outputs include the annual precipitation raster, a feature collection with mean precipitation per watershed, and area values for each polygon for further analysis.

original_task_name: Identify alert buffer near peat forests

task_name: Detect irrigated areas with NDVI-temperature masking
task_description: Filter Landsat imagery by date and cloud criteria, build median composites, compute NDVI and temperature-derived images, combine threshold conditions, apply the resulting irrigation mask, multiply by pixel area, and reduce the masked area over the region.
original_task_description: The script identifies irrigated agricultural areas in the Miandoab region using multi-temporal Landsat 8 TOA reflectance data from 2019. It computes NDVI and land surface temperature (LST) from nine cloud-free median composite images, calculates mean NDVI and mean LST, then applies a threshold-based mask (NDVI > 0.3 and LST < 33°C) to detect irrigated zones. Outputs include a binary irrigation mask, its area calculation in square meters, and histograms of mean NDVI and temperature for analysis.
